text.tspan: A bare-metal x86-64 exokernel. The kernel multiplexes hardware and enforces ownership; files, the shell and Doom itself are library OS code in ring 3.

g.text: RING 3 · LibOS programs, each in its own address space
syscall / sysretq · 41 numbers (#0–#40, #9–#16 reserved and never bound) · pointer arguments validated against the LibOS window
RING 0 · the exokernel (freestanding C + x86-64 assembly, no libc)
↑ IRQs · ↓ port I/O · MMIO · DMA (drivers are the only code that touches hardware; ring-3 in/out raises #GP)
HARDWARE · QEMU x86-64, 256 MiB, VESA framebuffer from GRUB (Multiboot 2)

text.tspan: supervisor-only mappings · one CPU, IF clear for the whole syscall
built -mno-sse, so no XMM state is saved on entry
